svg.title: Handle dry and deuterated solvents
svg.desc: Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
svg.text: The deuterated solvents are similarly dried and stored.
Purification toluene comes from a solvent still and is stored
over activated 3 Å sieves in the nitrogen glovebox; the exact
deuterated-solvent drying steps are not separately specified.
Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
